name: impossible-is-expensive
why: Opens on the line everyone uses (curing disease is impossible), knocks the IMPOSSIBLE wall down with three facts and a finger, and pays off with the treaty getting money over EXPENSIVE one bill in a hundred until it falls too.

name: print-you-a-new-brain
why: A courtroom where a 3D printer turns out windpipes, skulls and Yoda figurines on request, and the punchline prints the viewer a new brain so he can follow the argument.

name: steal-a-jellyfishs-homework
why: A zoo of animals that don't age while YOU ages a little at every enclosure, dies beside the polyp that cracked eternal life, and his skeleton gets stung copying the jellyfish's homework.
